requirement: Public/free access or explicit NWR license
reason: NWR cannot treat proprietary or restricted route data as source-safe.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: License terms, contract, public release terms, or written permission.

reason: Future lanes need reproducible retrieval without scraping fragile displays.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Documented package, endpoint, export, or download URL with usage instructions.
notes: Screenshots or ad hoc webpages do not qualify.

reason: Walk-forward validation requires frozen historical seasons.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Historical files by season/week with retrieval dates, versions, and archived receipts.

reason: NWR must know exactly what routes_run, route participation, and route type fields mean.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Data dictionary defining row grain, route counting rules, inclusions, exclusions, and updates.

reason: True YPRR/TPRR requires player routes run as denominator.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Field or derivation proof showing full routes run for each eligible player on pass plays.
notes: Primary-receiver labels, snaps, targets, and pass attempts fail.

reason: Denominator must cover targeted and non-targeted eligible receivers across WR, TE, and RB where applicable.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Coverage proof by position, player, game, week, and pass-play eligibility.
notes: Partial WR/TE display is not enough for broad source admission.

reason: NWR cannot approve name-only route joins.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: GSIS IDs, PFR IDs with audited crosswalk, or durable provider IDs mapped to NWR IDs.

reason: Route rows need stable football context for validation and leakage controls.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Game IDs, season, week, team, opponent, and play IDs if row grain is play-level.
notes: Season-only rows may be insufficient for deeper audits.

reason: YPRR/TPRR require joining route denominator to receiving yards and targets safely.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Documented join keys to targets, receiving yards, first downs, and player/team stats.

reason: Route data can be biased by position, player role, season, vendor thresholds, or missing games.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Coverage by season, week, team, position, player, and missingness reason.
notes: Must include inactive/injured and low-snap behavior.

reason: Future review needs frozen inputs and reproducibility.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: File hashes, retrieval timestamps, source version, and storage path.
Proof that data used for season N would have been available before N+1 evaluation point.
notes: Current pages with retroactive updates need special controls.

reason: Route surfaces can revise after games or seasons.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Documentation of update timing, retroactive corrections, and finalization date.

requirement: No proprietary derived grades mixed into factual route fields
reason: Route denominator must be source-safe factual data, not hidden analyst grades.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Field separation proof and blocked-field scan.
notes: Route counts may be admissible while grades remain blocked only if fields are separable.

reason: Source admission is separate from metric performance testing.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Source admission packet, source status matrix update, identity audit, and validation readiness checklist.
notes: Admission would still not approve production.

requirement: Master HQ approval for source-status change
reason: This lane does not promote any source.
candidate_source_evidence_needed: Separate source-hardening lane verdict and canonicalization approval.
notes: Until then route denominator status remains blocked.
